label: Gloss button
desc: A glossy dark button with a pointer-following specular band, a slow liquid sheen on hover, a squashed pressed state and a loading spinner; dark and accent variants.
use: primary call to action on landing pages, sign-in, checkout or publish actions

label: Upload progress
desc: A file picker and drop target that shows upload progress as a ball arcing into a hoop, with percentage, cancel, retry, error and success states.
use: asset or document upload on a dashboard, connect page or publishing form
